quests.title: Good Hunter Express

dialogue.sit: I'd love to, but I have to get going.

dialogue.t: Eh? Oh, alright then. I'll ask somebody else. I don't get it... Why is everybody ordering take-out lately?
Just remember not to get hit or run too fast. I don't think Wallit will accept Tea Break Pancakes that look all messed up.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Short-Tempered Wallit

dialogue.t: Why isn't it here yet? I have things to do, you know!

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: That's right. Great timing, Traveler! Wallit ordered a stack of Tea Break Pancakes from us earlier. Don't worry, he's already paid beforehand.
He wants us to bring it to a place south of Brightcrown Canyon...
But we've been getting more and more take-out orders lately for some reason, and we can barely keep up.
If you don't mind, could you help us with this delivery?
Oh, it's finally here, is it? Give it here — I have things to do and places to be.
I've heard that you can find suitable brewing ingredients around these parts...

quests.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...
